claims.text: This trip is an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip: the fare_breakdown records fare_model 'UPFRONT_QUOTE' with quoted_fare_sgd 45.00, so the distance and time charges were fixed when the rider booked and POL-RD-11, not the metered recomputation in POL-RD-02, governs what the rider can recover. The rider's complaint is not that the driver drove a longer road; it is that the platform billed 55.20 against the 45.00 it had locked.

The rider was charged 55.20 against a locked quote of 45.00 - an excess of exactly 10.20 - and the ledger's own published remedy figure for this trip is pol_rd_11_remedy 10.20, with pol_rd_11_remedy_available true. The platform's own arithmetic already identifies 10.20 as the amount refundable under POL-RD-11(a); the tribunal does not have to invent a figure.

No pass-through or statutory line reduces that figure. The fare_breakdown itemises no ERP gantry at all (erp_lines empty, total 0.00), an airport surcharge of 0.00 - correct, because the trip ENDS at Changi and does not originate there, and no surcharge line was in fact added - and a waiting-time fee of 0.00, so properly_chargeable.total is 0.00 and the whole 10.20 by which the charge exceeds the quote is refundable under POL-RD-11(a) read with POL-RD-09.

On the deviation question the rider concedes the record. The trace distance is 19.76 km against an optimal of 19.6 km, an excess of 0.16 km, or 0.82% - under both POL-RD-01 gates of 0.8 km absolute and 20% - so no route deviation is established and the rider does not press one. That concession does not end the case. POL-RD-11(a) refunds the amount by which charged_total exceeds the locked quote, and it is available on its own terms whether or not a deviation exists; POL-RD-01's default speaks to deviation claims, and its 'save for' carve-out does not extinguish the separate upfront-quote remedy whose own licence array includes PARTIAL_REFUND.

Nothing in this trip justifies a dollar above the quote. The driver's own account on file is that he drove the route the app gave, with no detours and no waiting; the trace confirms no deviation; and the ledger charges a waiting-time fee of 0.00. The 10.20 is therefore payment for no distance, time, ERP, surcharge or waiting that the rider received, and under POL-RD-11 the driver's own cost position cannot make it recoverable from the rider.

No escalation trigger fires, so the money should move rather than be held. The trace is complete and unimpaired for POL-RD-07 purposes - 145 fixes at a 10 second cadence, coverage 100%, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0, so limbs (a) to (c) are not met - and the deciding facts (quoted fare, charged total, pass-through lines) all sit on EV-FARE-00506 at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the 0.70 floor by POL-GEN-02(2) and neither POL-RD-10(1) nor POL-RD-10(3) applies.

No external traffic cause can offset the remedy either. The only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00506-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT: no advisory covers the PIE eastbound in this window. The artifact is relied on only for its absence, which is itself citable. The driver asserts no queue, breakdown or closure, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run on this record; and because no party cites an advisory, POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged, as POL-RD-13(1) provides. There is nothing here to exonerate.

The disputed money is presently carried by the rider, not the platform: payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so the 10.20 over the locked quote is still sitting on the rider's bill. Under POL-GEN-03, a ruling that returns the POL-RD-11(a) amount is a PARTIAL_REFUND of the contested sum, and it is the only outcome on this record that takes the overcharge off the filing rider.

claims.text: This trip's own trace shows no route deviation at all. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing measurement, and it records 19.76 km against a booked optimal of 19.6 km - an excess of 0.16 km, or 0.816% of optimal. Both establishment gates must pass and both fail by an order of magnitude: 0.16 km is far below the 0.8 km absolute threshold, and 0.816% is far below the 20% proportional threshold. Where either test fails, POL-RD-01 states that no deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip.

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and has not discharged its second limb. Limb (a) is satisfied - trip_id TRP-00506 matches across the trip record, the trace and the fare breakdown - but limb (b) requires an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold, and the unimpaired trace yields 0.16 km / 0.816%. The burden therefore never shifts to the driver, and the driver needs no exculpatory clause, because there is no excess to excuse.

Every other artifact corroborates a direct, uninterrupted drive on the route the platform assigned. The trip record shows actual_duration_min 24.0 against optimal_duration_min 24.0 - parity to the tenth of a minute - with wait_time_min 1.0, no pickup amendment and no dropoff amendment, on a RYDE_XL vehicle. The trace covers 100% of the trip with 145 fixes, an empty gaps list and a maximum gap of 0 seconds. The billed distance (19.8 km) does not fall short of the trace (19.76 km), so no unbilled-distance question arises either.

This is an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip with quoted_fare_sgd 45.00, so POL-RD-11 governs and POL-RD-02 does not run: the distance and time charges were fixed at booking and no distance-or-time refund is available to the rider however large the excess. The rider's remedy is confined to (a) the amount by which charged_total exceeds the quote plus any properly chargeable pass-through line, and (b) a POL-RD-09 correction - and here the pass-throughs are nil: erp_gantries is empty, the airport surcharge line is 0.00 (this trip ENDS at Changi T3, it does not originate there), and the waiting fee is 0.00. On the platform's own arithmetic the over-quote differential is 10.20, so the 55.20 the rider contests is unreachable in any event, and no part of that differential is attributable to a deviation or to the driver's driving.

No rider instruction of any kind is on the record. The in-app chat log for this trip contains zero messages and no timestamps, so there is no POL-RD-04 detour request, no named stop and no named road - and equally no in-trip complaint about the route. The driver drove the route the app gave him, and the only route measurement in the bundle is the trace showing 0.82% variation from optimal.

Nothing in the driver's record supports an adverse finding against him. POL-RD-06 is not even engaged, because it is consulted only on a MATERIAL deviation and 0.16 km is nowhere near the materiality gate of 8.0 km or 50% of optimal. Were it consulted, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 250, so no pattern is established, no FULL_REFUND uplift follows and no conduct referral is warranted. The remaining profile fields - rating, acceptance rate, account age, lifetime trips - are context only under POL-GEN-01 and can never ground a finding.

The trace is clean for policy purposes and the case is decidable on the present record. POL-RD-07's impairment limbs do not fire: 145 fixes at a 10-second cadence, coverage 100%, an empty gaps list, max_gap_sec 0.0, no straight-line jump above 500 m and no sampling interval above 30 seconds. POL-RD-10(3) therefore has no trigger, so the route question can be settled now rather than held for a human reviewer.

I disclose an impaired artifact: EV-ADVIS-00506-01 is the traffic advisory and it carries admissibility status MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight_multiplier 0.0 with no payload, because no advisory covers the PIE eastbound in this window. Its effect is neutral here. POL-RD-03 exoneration needs an advisory naming a segment the optimal route traverses, and POL-RD-13 tests only a traffic excuse a party actually asserts - the driver asserts none. The booked optimal of 19.6 km therefore remains the only baseline in the record, and no closure adjustment changes the measured excess.

On this rider-filed dispute the present state is payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and POL-GEN-03 makes NO_ACTION party-relative: it leaves that state as it is. Because no deviation exists, no distance-or-time refund runs on an upfront-quoted trip, and no chargeable pass-through line is present, the rider's route claim is not supported by this trip's evidence and no adverse finding, uplift or conduct referral should issue against the driver. To the extent the fare model produced any differential, that is a platform billing computation on the rider's own account, not a route finding against the man who drove the app's route.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties, on trip TRP-00506.

THE DRIVING — no deviation. The governing measurement is the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00506, weight 1.0): 19.76 km against a booked optimal of 19.6 km, an excess of 0.16 km, or 0.82%. POL-RD-01 requires an excess greater than both 0.8 km and 20% before a deviation is established; both gates fail, so no deviation exists and no refund follows on that limb however the trip is characterised. That is not a criticism of the driver: he drove the route the app gave him, and the trace is complete (145 fixes at a 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, empty gaps list, max gap 0.0, no jump over 500 m), so POL-RD-07 does not impair it and POL-RD-10(3) has no trigger. POL-RD-06 is not engaged (no material deviation); had it been consulted, deviation_flags_90d 0 over completed_trips_90d 250 establishes no pattern, so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral. Profile fields such as rating, acceptance rate, account age and lifetime trips are context only under POL-GEN-01 and were not used as a ground of decision.

THE MONEY — the rider wins on the fare limb. This is an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip: quoted_fare_sgd 45.00 and charged_total 55.20, both on EV-FARE-00506 at weight 1.0. POL-RD-02 does not run on an upfront-quoted trip, so no distance-or-time recomputation is performed. Under POL-RD-11(a) the rider recovers the amount by which charged_total (55.20) exceeds quoted_fare_sgd (45.00) plus the pass-through and statutory lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09: ERP 0.00 (no gantry lines at all), airport surcharge 0.00 (correct — this trip ENDS at Changi T3, it does not originate at an airport), waiting_time_fee 0.00. The refund is therefore 10.20 — the same figure the ledger itself publishes as pol_rd_11_remedy 10.20 with pol_rd_11_remedy_available true.

The driver's case for NO_ACTION is accepted as to the route and rejected as to the money. POL-RD-11(a) refunds the over-quote amount on its own terms whether or not a deviation exists, and the refund is not a penalty on the driver: his account (drove the app's route, no detours, no waiting) is consistent with the trace, and the charge he is not responsible for is a platform billing computation, exactly as the rider says. No driver compensation is granted: the billed distance (19.8 km) does not fall short of the trace (19.76 km), so POL-RD-04's unbilled-distance limb does not arise. The rider's concession that no deviation is established is accepted; the claim succeeds only on the fare limb.

The missing advisory EV-ADVIS-00506-01 (status MISSING, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0) can carry no fact; its absence is citable but neutral here. No party asserts an external traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run on this record and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged, as POL-RD-13(1) provides.

ESCALATION: no POL-RD-10 trigger fires — identifiers match across trip record, trace and ledger; the trace is unimpaired and the money facts are carried by the fare ledger; timestamps agree; the only absent artifact is one nobody relies on for a fact; and each charge line has a counterpart in the trip record. No referral is made, because no clause produces one: POL-RD-06(c) needs a material, substantiated deviation and an established pattern (neither exists), and POL-RD-09(4) needs an unmatched gantry line or a wrongly applied airport surcharge (there are none — erp_lines is empty and the surcharge line is 0.00). If the platform wishes to understand why an upfront quote was exceeded by 10.20, that is an internal question and belongs here, not in a referral.

OUTCOME: PARTIAL_REFUND — SGD 10.20 of the SGD 55.20 contested is returned to the rider. payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so the 10.20 comes off the rider's bill. Confidence 0.90: the deciding figures sit on EV-FARE-00506 at weight_multiplier 1.0 and nothing rests on an impaired artifact.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this dispute is really about the fare, not the road, and the money moves on the fare question.

THE ROUTE. The GPS trace for TRP-00506 measures 19.76 km against a booked optimal of 19.6 km — an excess of 0.16 km, or 0.82%. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only when the excess is above both 0.8 km and 20% of optimal; neither gate is remotely met (the trace figure governs over the trip record's rounded 19.8 km copy). No route deviation exists, so nothing said about the driver's driving is upheld against him, no POL-RD-06 repeat-deviation check is engaged (0.16 km is nowhere near the 8.0 km / 50% materiality gate, and in any event deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 250), and no conduct referral issues. No POL-RD-04 driver compensation arises either: the billed distance (19.8 km) does not fall short of the trace, so there is no unbilled distance to compensate. The driver's submission that no adverse route finding should issue against him is ACCEPTED.

THE FARE. The trip was booked on an UPFRONT_QUOTE with a locked fare of SGD 45.00, and SGD 55.20 was charged. POL-RD-11(a) refunds the amount by which charged_total exceeds the locked quote plus any properly chargeable pass-through line. The fare breakdown itemises no ERP (erp_lines empty, 0.00), no airport surcharge (0.00, which is correct because this trip ENDS at Changi T3 and does not originate there) and no waiting-time fee (0.00), so properly chargeable is 0.00 and the refund is 55.20 − 45.00 − 0.00 = SGD 10.20. POL-RD-02 does not run on an upfront-quoted trip, so the distance and time charges are not recomputed and the rider recovers nothing on those lines; the SGD 10.20 is the whole of the relief, not the SGD 55.20 contested. The driver's own filing concedes the 10.20 over-quote differential on the platform's arithmetic; his submission that the outcome should be NO_ACTION is therefore accepted only so far as it concerns him — no money moves against him — and rejected as to the rider, because POL-GEN-03's NO_ACTION preserves the present state and the present state is a charge of 55.20 of which 10.20 was never properly chargeable.

CONFIDENCE AND ESCALATION. The deciding figures sit on EV-FARE-00506 at weight 1.0, and the no-deviation finding sits on EV-GPS-00506 and EV-TRIP-00506, both at weight 1.0; the trace is complete (145 fixes at a 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, empty gaps list, max gap 0 s) and clean under POL-RD-07(a)–(c). Trip identifiers and timestamps match across the artifacts, and no charge line lacks a counterpart. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires, so the case is decided rather than held. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00506-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, but no party asserts a traffic cause (the driver expressly says he drove the route the app gave) and neither advocate relies on it as an exculpatory record, so it decides nothing; under POL-RD-13 its absence is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. No clause produces a referral on these facts.

NET RESULT. The rider is refunded SGD 10.20 of the SGD 55.20 contested; the rest of the charge stands as the amount properly chargeable above the locked quote. The driver owes nothing and is owed nothing.

To the rider — you are right about the money, but not about the route. Your own trip trace (EV-GPS-00506) records 19.76 km driven against a booked optimal of 19.6 km: an excess of 0.16 km, or 0.82%. POL-RD-01 requires an excess greater than 0.8 km AND greater than 20% before any deviation is established; both gates fail by an order of magnitude, so no route deviation exists, no POL-RD-02 recomputation runs, and nothing issues against the driver. The money finding is separate and it is yours. This trip was booked as an UPFRONT_QUOTE at SGD 45.00 (fare_breakdown.quoted_fare_sgd on EV-FARE-00506) and you were charged SGD 55.20. Nothing beyond the quote was properly chargeable: erp_lines is empty (SGD 0.00), the airport surcharge is SGD 0.00 (the trip ENDS at Changi Terminal 3; a trip that ends at an airport carries no surcharge), and the waiting fee is SGD 0.00 — so properly_chargeable.total is SGD 0.00. Under POL-RD-11(a) the SGD 10.20 by which charged_total exceeds the locked quote plus those lines is refunded in full; rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 it remains SGD 10.20. That is a PARTIAL_REFUND of the SGD 55.20 you contested, leaving the charge standing only in its reduced form.

To the driver — your account is accepted and no adverse finding issues against you. You drove the route the app gave you: the trace covers 100% of the trip with 145 fixes at a 10-second cadence, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, and a measured excess of 0.16 km over the booked optimal. The in-app chat log for this trip holds zero messages, so there is no rider instruction to detour and no in-trip complaint about your driving. POL-RD-06 is not engaged — its materiality gate (8.0 km or 50%) is nowhere near 0.16 km — and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 250 completed trips, so no pattern, no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral. POL-RD-04's unbilled-distance limb does not arise either, because the billed distance (19.8 km) is not short of the trace (19.76 km). Your conclusion that this is NO_ACTION does not follow, however: on an upfront-quoted trip POL-RD-11(a) refunds the amount charged over the locked quote whether or not a deviation exists, and the SGD 10.20 gap is accounted for by no distance, time, ERP, surcharge or waiting line. POL-RD-01's default speaks to the deviation question; it does not extinguish the POL-RD-11 remedy that the fare ledger itself publishes as available. Your point that no part of the differential is attributable to a deviation or to your driving is accepted.

On the traffic advisory. EV-ADVIS-00506-01 is MISSING, with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — no advisory covers the PIE eastbound in this window. No party asserted an external traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and nothing turns on it: the advisory is cited only for its absence, it carries no fact in either direction, and it neither exonerates under POL-RD-03 nor escalates under POL-RD-10(5) (POL-RD-13(1)). No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trip identifier TRP-00506 matches across trip record, trace and fare breakdown; the trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c); the refund is far below SGD 150 and below charged_total; and every charged line corresponds to the trace and trip record.

Confidence is 0.90. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact — EV-FARE-00506 (quoted fare, charged total and pass-through lines), EV-GPS-00506 and EV-TRIP-00506 (the no-deviation finding) — is at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0; the MISSING advisory at 0.0 carries no fact and does not lower it. No referral is produced: POL-RD-06(c) is not engaged (no material deviation, no pattern) and POL-RD-09(4) is not engaged (no unmatched gantry and no wrongly applied surcharge).

To both parties: the route complaint fails, but the bill does not stand, and the two questions are decided separately.

THE ROUTE. Both advocates read the trace the same way and so do I.
